benefit_text: The scheme gives a short‑term credit limit for the first year based on the crop finance scale, plus 10% for post‑harvest needs, 20% for repairs, and insurance. In later years the limit adds 10% for cost escalation and includes a term‑loan component for up to five years, forming the maximum permissible limit.
who_can_apply: Farmers who own cultivations can apply. Tenant farmers, oral lessees and share croppers are also eligible. Groups of farmers such as SHGs or JLGs can apply as well. There is no age or income rule specified.
documents: Application form, two passport size photographs, ID proof like Aadhar or voter ID, address proof, certified landholding proof, cropping pattern details, security documents if loan exceeds Rs.1.60 lakhs or Rs.3.00 lakhs.
how_to_apply: Visit the bank’s website, choose Kisan Credit Card and click Apply. Fill the online form with required details and submit. You will receive a reference number and the bank will contact you within a few working days. You may also apply offline at the bank branch.
